newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Same Time issues 26 million new shares.
newsitem.headline: Same Time issues 26 million new shares.

text.p: Same Time Holdings Ltd said on Friday it is issuing 26 million new shares to its controlling shareholders, who will place the same number of existing shares with independent private and institutional investors.
The existing shares will be placed by Sum Tai Holdings Ltd at HK$0.76 each, and the new shares will be subscribed to at the same price adjusted for expenses of the placement and new issue.

The placing price represented a discount of about 7.32 percent to the average closing price of the share of HK$0.82 for the last 10 business days and a discount of about 9.52 percent to the company's closing price of HK$0.84 on April 17.
The placement, to be completed on or before April 21, represented about 9.09 percent of the existing issued share capital of the company and 8.33 percent of its enlarged issued share capital.

The aggregate shareholding of Sum Tai, owned by Same Time directors Yip Sum Yin and Yu Hung Ming, and Maroc Ventures Inc, owned by Same Time director Yip How Yin, would be reduced from 58.92 percent to 54.01 percent of the enlarged issued share capital following the placement and new issue.
The electronics maker said the HK$19 million in net proceeds were intended to be used for working capital purposes.
